articles.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, who played dads, cops and commanding officers, has died
articles.summary: Veteran actor Tom Skerritt is lauded for his distinctively rugged persona, characterized by his mustache, jaw, and authoritarian bearing. He is notably remembered for his compelling portrayals of commanding officers and fathers, bringing significant gravitas to these memorable roles. His impactful screen presence, especially in leadership capacities, has left a lasting mark on audiences, embodying strong figures.

articles.title: Tom Skerritt, Star of ‘Alien,’ ‘Top Gun,’ ‘Picket Fences,’ Dies at 93
articles.summary: Emmy-winning actor Tom Skerritt, celebrated for his portrayal of solid, wry authority figures, has passed away. He was widely recognized for iconic roles such as Viper, the flight instructor in the defence-themed blockbuster "Top Gun," and as Sheriff Jimmy Brock in the acclaimed TV series "Picket Fences." His extensive career left a significant mark on film and television.

articles.title: Reds mourn death of member of 1990 World Series championship team
articles.summary: Todd Benzinger, former Dayton Dragons manager and Cincinnati Reds player, renowned for catching the final out of the 1990 World Series, passed away at 63 on October 21. His death was officially announced by the Reds. Benzinger was a significant figure in baseball history, whose memorable contribution sealed the Reds' championship run.

articles.title: Russia, Ukraine exchange strikes despite renewed US push for peace
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine continue missile and drone exchanges, despite renewed US-led peace efforts. Both nations have signalled openness to talks in November, but significant differences over territorial demands persist. This indicates the ongoing military engagement coupled with complex diplomatic challenges in the prolonged conflict.
